text:
mira: customer reports duplicate tool_call billing when a stream got truncated and client retried. ledger shows two completed toolcall rows. repro logs attached.

chuck: hmm. do we currently treat toolcall tokens as part of stream or separately? iirc toolcalls write standalone ledger entries.

raine: yes separate. problem is truncation path never emits tool_call_ack, so client reconnect triggers the toolcall again -> second ack and charge.

kevin: we should create provisional ledger rows on tool_call_start and only commit on ack. also need server-side fingerprinting for dedupe if client doesn't send an idempotency key.

mira: agreed. propose fingerprint = sha256(route + session_id + tool_name + canonical_args). store with provisional=true and TTL 2m.

chuck: console UX: mark provisional rows clearly and exclude them from billing exports by default. ops can view/include with a toggle.

rain: edge: if reconnect returns partial tokens before ack, attach to provisional row if fingerprint matches. otherwise, treat as new.

ops-bot: plan: spec events tool_call_start/tool_call_ack/tool_call_expire, ledger add fields [provisional,fingerprint], canary rollout 5% tomorrow.

mira: i'll draft spec + small migration notes. kevin, can you prototype fingerprinting in sidecar?
